# PDF.js

PDF.js 6.5.438, from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz

The legacy browser build and matching worker are self-hosted here so the CV
preview does not require a browser PDF plugin or an external CDN. See LICENSE
for the Apache 2.0 license and the upstream project at https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/.
